required_docs.doc: [one or more of] A certificate of declaration of death issued by the attending physician  ((ক))
[one or more of] A death certificate issued by the relevant medical institution  ((খ))
[one or more of] A copy of the post-mortem (ময়না তদন্ত) report for the deceased  ((গ))
[one or more of] Any other death-related document the registrar considers necessary  ((ঘ))
[if applying after 45 days] A written explanation of the reason for the delay, in addition to the certifications or documents already required  (Rule 11(9))
